items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And like Jeanette MacDonald, all those — beautiful music. It was beautiful you know. But that’s what they did.

ctx.x: Way back. Yeah. And like Jeanette MacDonald, all those — beautiful music. It was beautiful you know. But that’s what they did. Everybody, we always played, there was always something going on. There was a string quartet in the front room. And we lived in a little A frame house. There was no room really, on Seymour Avenue, which is gone now, it’s a parking lot. But there was always music happening. You know my brother was always playing or there was a trio or a singer would come in and rehearse tunes with Torrie…
